description: Summarize EPA-regulated facilities for a whole US state or territory: facility and county counts, inspections, formal enforcement actions, total penalties, facilities currently in violation or significant violation, and the counties with the most facilities in violation. Data is EPA ECHO (latest monthly ECHO Exporter snapshot; states report to EPA on their own schedules, so very recent enforcement can lag). Use get_county_compliance_summary instead for one county, and list_facilities_with_violations for the facility-level worst-first list.
name: get_state_compliance_summary
